changes.before: Read the statements carefully. Statement 1: M1 measure of money supply constitutes currency and demand deposits held by the public. Statement 2: Demand deposits are those deposits with commercial banks that can be withdrawn on demand by depositors. Choose the correct option.
changes.after: Read the statements carefully. Statement 1: Under the Class XII NCERT narrow-money definition, M1 is currency held by the public plus net demand deposits held with commercial banks. Statement 2: Demand deposits are those deposits with commercial banks that can be withdrawn on demand by depositors. Choose the correct option.
changes.rationale: Pin the intended M1 convention to the current course definition so the answer is not dependent on a broader statistical series.

changes.before: The Government of India in its Union Budget 2026-27 has decided to exempt fish caught by Indian fishing vessels operating in the Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) and on the High Seas from duty. Identify the objective behind the initiative taken by the Government of India as stated above. (Choose the correct option)
changes.after: In a hypothetical example, the government uses budget funds to provide roads, a public good that cannot be provided to all users through market exchange. Which objective/function of the government budget does this illustrate? (Choose the correct option)
changes.rationale: Replace unstated real-world policy intent with a hypothetical that matches the official NCERT allocation-function example of roads/public goods.
